summary: Frontend-only verification of login UI cleanup, guest OTP boxes, and support chat composer. All 3 bug fixes verified functional. Minor observations noted.

issues: login-features chips container horizontally overlaps login-hero bounding box by ~66px (spec asked <=20px). Visually there is NO overlap because chips sit BELOW hero (feat.top=304 > hero.bottom=299). If the intent is horizontal-only measurement, chips container spans left:18..right:250/267 vs hero left:184/201..right:360/390. May want to further narrow chip container width or ensure grid layout so horizontal boxes are also disjoint.
Panel height measured 917px (not ~520px as expected in spec). Composer (support-reply-input) is visible and typing/sending works. useKeyboardState shrink behavior cannot be exercised in headless web.

test_results.guest_otp_disabled_state: Could NOT force verify-button into disabled state via DOM clearing of hidden otp-code input — React state (boxes) remained filled after JS setter/keyboard clear. Note: When user actually clears via UI (Change/Resend) with fresh phone, boxes render empty initially; but for our numbers dev OTP is auto-injected. Behavior may be intentional dev-only convenience. Cannot confirm 'disabled until 6 digits' invariant end-to-end.

action_items: Consider narrowing login-features chips container width so its horizontal bounding box does not overlap the login-hero image (currently 66px horizontal intersection; the spec asked <=20px). Note there is no visual overlap because chips are placed below the hero vertically.
Support panel height measured 917px (not ~520px per spec). Confirm whether panelH default value or CSS is correct for expo-web viewport 390x844.
Consider adding a UI-level 'clear boxes' path so testers can exercise the 'verify disabled until 6 digits typed' invariant; currently dev OTP auto-prefill keeps state=6-digits.
